narrative.overview: A buyer's working tool drawn as a tensegrity structure. Every offer is a strut, the ceiling a fixed member nothing may cross, and the negotiation a red cord pulling each strut toward it. Translated onto Aonic's own off-white ground and type.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper ground, hairline rules, no shadow
Inter Tight for words, JetBrains Mono for every number and label
Red only where something is under live load
Every automated decision shown with its reason

rules.name: The One Force Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where something is under load right now.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every verdict pairs its colour with a mark and a word.

rules.name: The Assumption Rule
rules.body: Anything not read from a supplier or from Aonic sits on a sand notice that says so.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Words in Inter Tight, measurements in JetBrains Mono.

dos: Do show the reason beside every automated decision.
Do set every figure in tabular mono with its sign and unit.
Do keep walked-away and void items visible, struck in ink 3.
Do label anything simulated or assumed.
Do write each control as the action it takes.
donts: Don't use red for anything not under live load.
Don't put data in a grid of same-size cards.
Don't let a verdict rely on colour alone.
Don't add a label above a heading.
